description.value: Bon Sushi is a neighbourhood sushi restaurant in Oak Bay, Victoria, serving a broad menu of Japanese fare including specialty rolls, sashimi, rice bowls, bento boxes, and party platters. Located on Hampshire Road, it is a full sit-down restaurant emphasizing fresh ingredients and house-favourite rolls like the Dragon Roll and TNT Roll. It would make a convenient stop for touring cyclists exploring the Oak Bay area.
